paper_title: Paper Copilot A Self-Evolving and Efficient LLM System for Personalized   Academic Assistance
caption: Feature pre-computation significantly improves the efficiency. The time cost for retrieval without feature pre-computation will grow with the exponential increase of paper number, while our proposed feature pre-computation stays unchanged and keeps constant time cost.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the time cost in seconds as a function of the paper number. The x-axis, labeled “Paper Number,” ranges from 1 to 256 and employs a linear scale with tick intervals of one. The y-axis, labeled “Time Cost (s),” extends from approximately 0 to 35, utilizing a linear scale with tick intervals of 5. A solid blue line represents the time cost incurred without pre-computation, beginning at approximately 0 seconds at paper number 1 and increasing to approximately 31 seconds at paper number 256.  An orange solid line represents the time cost with pre-computation, starting at approximately 1 second at paper number 1 and reaching approximately 1 second at paper number 256.
